summary: Unexpected information can overturn a plan faster than everyone involved can agree on what the new facts actually mean.
body: Unexpected information can overturn a plan faster than everyone involved can agree on what the new facts actually mean. When Mercury opposes Uranus, information and disruption face each other directly, bringing surprises, reversals, contradictory messages, and sudden changes of perspective. The first update may be important without being complete. Isolate the confirmed change from the surrounding panic and speculation. Halt major decisions until the dust settles, and only rebuild the strategy around facts that are actually locked in.
